name: Tipitaka Pali Reader
blurb: Tipitaka Pali Reader (TPR) is designed for reading and studying Pāḷi texts.
description:
Tipitaka Pali Reader (TPR) is designed for reading and studying Pāḷi texts.
It offers integrated dictionary support, multi-language definitions, and
support for various scripts. Ideal for students of early Buddhist texts, it
enables fast lookup of word meanings and root structures.

• The whole Tipitaka with commentaries and sub-commentaries, in many scripts

• Translations in many languages from ePitaka, shown beneath the Pāḷi

• Tap a word to see its meaning, grammar and root in several dictionaries

• Search the Pāḷi and the translations, in the script you read them in

• Page numbers of the Myanmar, VRI, PTS and Thai editions

• Bookmarks in folders, with cloud transfer between devices

May all beings benefit from this dhamma donation!
